senses.gloss: ch. same, to be of little value, disregarded.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 3:21">Targ. Prov. III, 21</cite> <he>לא נִזַל בעינך</he> (h. text <he>ילזו</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 4:21">Ib. IV, 21</cite> <he>לא נִיזְלָן בעיניך</he> Var. ed. Lag. a. oth. ed. (ed. Lag. <he>בעיניך</he>, v. <cite ref="G00491"><he>זְלֵי</he></cite>; h. text <he>יליזו מ־</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 27:16">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVII, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 16:4">Targ. Y. Gen. XVI, 4</cite> <he>זלזלת</he> (ed. pr. <he>זַלְּלַת</he>) she disregarded.—
<cite ref="Chullin 133a:5">Ḥull. 133ᵃ</cite> <he>זַלְזוּלֵי קא מְזַלְזֵל וכ׳</he> does he show that he treats religious observances with disrespect?, opp. <cite ref="H00012"><he>חבב</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35a:9">Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>ואתי לזַלְזוּלֵי בה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לזִילְזוּלָא</he>) and he may be induced to disregard it; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 52b:13">B. Mets. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>מְזַלְזְלִינָן במעשר שני</he> in redeeming second tithes we are permitted to count closely.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 52b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>תרי זילי לא מז׳</he> two lowerings of value must not be applied to it (to value closely and then to count a defective coin for full).

senses.gloss: ; contr. אִיזַּלְזֵל to be despised; to lower one’s self.
